title: Kids Virtual Piano
summary: A colourful virtual piano where kids learn nursery songs by following glowing notes.
body: Free play, guided songs, recording, and small rewards. Built with Next.js as an installable PWA.

title: Aura — Daily Motivational Quotes
summary: A daily-motivation web app that surfaces a curated quote each day across 13 topics — with streaks, custom affirmations, reminders, read-aloud, favourites, a shareable card-image export, and an embeddable widget.
body: Each day surfaces a curated quote and rewards returning with a streak counter. Quotes span 13 topics — Stoicism, Discipline, Mindfulness, Resilience, Leadership, Success and more — browsable from a topic rail.
Beyond reading: save favourites, add personal affirmations, hear quotes read aloud in a soft voice, copy them, or export a designed card image to share. A daily reminder schedule nudges you back.

Built as a client-rendered single-page app deployed on Vercel, with light/dark themes, selectable visual 'atmospheres', serif/sans typography, and an embeddable widget for dropping a quote into other sites.

title: Technical RAG Assistant
summary: Exploring Retrieval-Augmented Generation for technical documentation.
body: A learning project on retrieval, grounding, and how answer quality is measured.

title: MCP-Enabled Agent
summary: Learning the Model Context Protocol and the patterns behind agentic systems.
body: A small study of MCP servers and hosts, with a focus on auditable AI agents.

title: Student Contribution Playground
summary: A small C library where students practise the real contribution workflow — branch, PR, review, CI.
body: Open to forks so other educators can remix it for their own courses.

title: Maximising the Lifetime of a Wireless Sensor Network
summary: A meta-heuristic that chooses which sensors to activate so coverage holds while battery life is extended.
body: Python simulation framework behind the published ARSH-FATI papers.

title: Note App
body: Plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — used as a web-fundamentals teaching example.

title: Library Management System
summary: A web app for organising and browsing a home book collection.
body: PHP and MySQL back end with a searchable, filterable catalogue.

title: Hardware Trojan Detection Unit for NoC-based MPSoC
summary: Runtime detection of hardware Trojans hidden in third-party Network-on-Chip IP.
body: Simulated in an extended BookSim and implemented in Verilog; published in several IEEE papers.

title: Single-Cycle + Pipelined Processor with Assembly Interpreter
summary: A custom-ISA CPU in VHDL, single-cycle and pipelined, with a Python assembler.
body: Built as a teaching resource for computer architecture courses.

title: USB-Based PIC Microcontroller Development Kit
summary: A PIC development board for students learning microcontroller interfacing.
body: Board designed in Altium, with example C firmware for each peripheral.
